appearance.subtle: The hair on your arms lifts when they walk past.
appearance.obvious: Ridged organs run down both their flanks, and the air around them smells of ozone.
appearance.extreme: They crackle. Visible arcs jump between the stacked organs on their sides, and everything metal in the room is humming.

description: Stacked cells of modified muscle down your flanks, holding a charge. You can feel it building. Discharging it is a relief.
drawbacks: Electronics near you do not last
name: Electric Organ
